request.query:
GOAL: An email to a Finnish bank asking for an appointment to open an account with basic banking services (peruspankkipalvelut). Say what the person will bring, as stated in the facts. If a fact quotes the Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority (FIN-FSA) about what banks may require, mention it politely and quote it.

FACTS:
P1: I arrive in Helsinki on 1 December 2026.
P2: I am an EU citizen moving to Helsinki.
F1: To open an account: Passport or EU-citizen identity card (a driving license alone is not enough)
F2: To open an account: Proof of identity, Finnish personal identity code, proof of local address, and details of employment or study arrangements
F3: Maximum ten business days after the bank has received the request and all required documents
F4: FIN-FSA: "The FIN-FSA states as its interpretation that banks may not require a Finnish personal identity code as a precondition for opening basic banking services"
P3: I plan to visit the bank on 7 December 2026.

data.subject: Request for an appointment to open a basic bank account

sentences.text: I am an EU citizen moving to Helsinki, and I would like to book an appointment to open an account with basic banking services (peruspankkipalvelut).
I arrive in Helsinki on 1 December 2026 and plan to visit the bank on 7 December 2026.
I will bring my passport or EU-citizen identity card, since I understand a driving license alone is not enough.
I understand that the bank usually asks for proof of identity, a Finnish personal identity code, proof of local address, and details of employment or study arrangements.
I will bring what I have, and my employer or study place is [Employer or school name].

I have also read that the Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority says: "The FIN-FSA states as its interpretation that banks may not require a Finnish personal identity code as a precondition for opening basic banking services".
I would be grateful if you could tell me whether this applies to my situation and which documents you need from me.
I also understand the account should be opened within a maximum of ten business days after the bank has received the request and all required documents.
